label: [early-0244] W1 camps core: XP rules + the Camps module
task: Needs on origin: ext/early-base. Base: origin/ext/early-base. Branch: ext/early-camps-core. Spec: origin/ext/spec-early-camps:briefs/specs/EARLY_CAMPS_DROP.md sections 1, 2.1, 2.3, 2.4, 2.10. Goal: Hunters level by clearing monster camps, not by time or stray hits. First write docs/decisions/NNNN-camps-and-xp.md (match flow and combat XP are core systems). (A) XP rules. New content/rules/xp.json and scripts/match/xp_rules.gd; delete the inline numbers they replace. scripts/match/match.gd near line 1783: damage XP against monsters 0.35 per damage becomes 0, against Hunters 0.6 becomes 0.15. match.gd near 1850: knock XP 90 to the knocker becomes 40 + 15 x the victim's level, paid in full to every squadmate of the knocker who is alive or downed within 30 m. scripts/match/hunter.gd near 1918: trickle 1.2 XP/s becomes 0.25. Blight monsters and wanderers outside camps: 8 XP per kill, shared the same way. scripts/match/lairs.gd boss XP (260 by share) is unchanged. One helper, XpRules.pay_squad(match, hunter, xp), is the only place that knows the 30 m squad rule; knocks, camp clears and kill XP all call it. (B) Camps. New scripts/match/camps.gd and content/rules/camps.json. Move the body of Match._spawn_mobs (match.gd near 972) into it: match.gd and hunter.gd must end no longer than they started. Camps reads world.camp_spots ({pos, island, kind}) and keeps an explicit state per camp: LIVE, CLEARED, RETURNING, SPENT. Sizes by kind: light = Small Camp, 2 monsters, 60 XP, reward armor 25; normal = Camp, 3 monsters, 110 XP, armor 50 plus a perk orb half the time; heavy = Great Camp, 4 monsters with the region's Brute, 190 XP, armor 50 plus one perk orb plus one gear piece at the region's rarity; chief = Camp Chief, a Great Camp whose Brute is one rarity tier higher (reuse the existing mob tier and BiomeRun.dress), 240 XP, gear one rarity step up. Which monsters stays BiomeRun.camp_comp. In the hot zone (HotZone.region_at) every camp spawns one size up. Tag camp monsters with their camp id. When the last one dies: pay the camp's XP through XpRules.pay_squad to the squad of the Hunter who made the last kill (a rival squad's last hit takes the pay), show one toast 'Camp cleared  +110 XP', and drop the reward as one bundle where the last monster fell (reuse PerkOrbs.drop with a new source 'camp' in content/rules/perk_orbs.json and the existing armor and gear drops). Camp monsters skip the per-monster rolls in match.gd near 2236 (Brute orb 50%, valuable 25%, seeds 35% and 12%); the Rift Key chance and monsters outside camps keep theirs. Comeback: once per camp, 150 s after its clear, one size up (Small to Camp, Camp to Great, Great to Camp Chief), only if no Hunter is within 30 m and Camps.safe_for(pos, 60.0) is true; none after 7:00; never more than 85 camp monsters alive. Camps.safe_for is one function that wraps the current Blight ring radius at now + 60 s (the Blight zone redesign will replace only that function). Delete CAMP_RESPAWN, _camp_respawns and note_camp from scripts/match/rolling.gd with their callers: move the logic, do not copy it. API the other tasks use: Camps.list() returning {id, pos, size, state, back_t, region} per camp, Camps.nearest_live(pos, r), Camps.region_xp(region), and a cleared(id, squad) signal. Net: read how gain_xp and monster deaths are synced today and keep that authority; if camp state needs a new synced field, send it through Net and bump Net.VERSION. Proving check: new tools/camps_check.gd registered as `--camps-check`. It asserts: monster count and XP per size; three squadmates within 30 m each get the full XP, one at 40 m gets 0, a rival's last hit takes the pay; 0 XP from damage to monsters; the knock formula and its share; trickle 0.25/s; the bundle per size and no per-monster rolls from camp monsters; hot zone one size up; the comeback happens once, bigger, and is blocked by a near Hunter, by the Blight, and after 7:00; the 85 cap. Fix any check that asserted the old XP numbers and say why in the commit. Run `--camps-check`, `--hot-zone-check`, `--level-vfx-check`, `--check`, then `python3 tools/health.py --strict`. Report lines added and removed. Post READY on briefs/EXT_TO_MAIN.md with `ready-post 'READY ext/early-camps-core <sha> (camps pay XP and one reward; XP rules in data)'`.

VFX: one ring mesh at exactly the 6 m effect radius in team colour for 0.35 s, 36 pooled dust particles, 6 debris chunks without physics, one 2 m crack decal for 4 s; no light. In the last 30 m of the dive the reticle shows one line: 'Hold dive: Hard Landing'. Bots land hard half the time when Camps.nearest_live(their landing point, 8) finds a camp. On the GPU box through `jobq submit --needs gpu`: nine Hard Landings in one second stay under 4,000 particles on screen with no frame over 50 ms, and `--perf-bench` average is within +0.5 ms of the base. label: [early-0244] W2 bots drop on camps + the level pace sim
task: Needs on origin: ext/early-camps-core and ext/early-camps-layout. Base: origin/ext/early-camps-core with origin/ext/early-camps-layout merged in. Branch: ext/early-camps-bots. Spec: origin/ext/spec-early-camps:briefs/specs/EARLY_CAMPS_DROP.md sections 2.5, 2.8. Goal: bot squads play the early game the way the design asks, and a sim proves the level pace. New scripts/match/bot_camps.gd; scripts/match/bot.gd gets wiring lines only. Planning phase (scripts/match/drop_squad.gd, the bot ping): a bot squad leader with no human ping picks a camp, not a spot. The hot zone first at the existing HotZone.BOT_PICK 0.35 if no other squad has pinged it; otherwise a rim or mid region that at most one other squad has pinged, pinging its Small Camp (rim) or Camp (mid). Never two bot squads in one region; at most one bot squad a match takes the Crown. After landing: clear the region's camps from smallest to biggest using Camps.nearest_live; skip a camp where a squad with a higher total level is fighting; stop camping at 2:30 or when Camps.safe_for(pos, 60.0) turns false or the Blight is within 40 m, then hand over to the existing Limited Way Outs objectives. Mid-game, a bot squad whose best level is below 5 detours to a returning camp within 60 m. Numbers live in content/rules/camps.json under a bots block. Proving check: new tools/camp_pace_check.gd registered as `--camp-pace-check`, a seeded headless run of 10 bot trios on the 2x map over 5 seeds that prints one table (squad, level at 1:30, 2:30, 4:00, 5:15, XP by source) and asserts: bot squads average level 3.5 to 4.5 at 2:30; no Hunter is level 6 before 2:30 in at least 4 of 5 seeds; the median squad still alive is level 5.5 or more at 5:15; the top squad is at most 2 levels above the median at 4:00; at least 60% of all XP earned by 2:30 comes from camp clears; a squad scripted never to fight is level 2 or lower at 5:15; no two bot squads ping one region. If the pace misses, tune content/rules/camps.json and content/rules/xp.json by at most 20% and report the change; do not widen the check. Also run `--camps-check`, `--hot-zone-check`, `--simtest --teams=10 --squad=3 --god` to its end with no script errors, and `python3 tools/health.py --strict`. Post READY on briefs/EXT_TO_MAIN.md with `ready-post 'READY ext/early-camps-bots <sha> (bots drop on camps; pace sim green)'`.
